podcast.title: Death Details - March 12, 2024
podcast.body: Rusty Wilson died on March 12, 2024, at the age of 62. His cause of death was meningitis. "He was 62 when he was claimed by men in Gytus."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Background as Bar-Bouncer
podcast.body: Rusty Wilson was an ex-bar-bouncer before being recruited by Tom Wilson to become the bass player for the Canadian band Junkhouse. "He was an ex-bar-bouncer who was recruited by Tom Wilson, in relation to be junkhouse's bass player."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
